items.title: 68191_William (Bill) H. Challis Oral History Interview
items.q: And they had Russ Case and Andy Secress.

ctx.x: The same thing would happen on the Kate Smith Show, which I did for three years. I remember one time changing what they wanted -- you know, what they wanted was Kate Smith sings the first chorus, and then for 16 bars you've got to bring the orchestra in, and they had four trumpets, four trombones. They had five saxophones, and they wanted them all, whether it was in -- whether it was all harmonized out, and they had guys like Charlie Margolis and -- and the guy that used to play -- play out in Detroit with us…
good friend of Bix's Vic, Nat Natoli. And they had Russ Case and Andy Secress.
So they figured they're paying for all those instruments, they want to hear them.
